auxiliary.policy: Fresh eight-parent A/B both-model strict and bounded continuation pairs, same base budgets; at most two additional unused public step callbacks after known no_progress or format fault. Preserve primary state/history/costs. No unknown retry.

primary: Within model, answerable parent paired verified_supported_completion A minus B. Grounded world-unknown abstention and reviewer-unknown are distinct. Small N is descriptive.
profile_selection: Largest 24/16 balanced new profile fitting a speed/resource-only forecast, including separate sensitivity and margin. Never select by A minus B.
public_gold_separation: Only new PublicTask reaches prompts, factories and selectors. Minimal exact GoldTask witnesses are evaluation-only. Same review and repair rules across A/B/C.
post_confirmation_changes: Measured bytes are immutable. Any change needs an explicit new protocol, unused confirmatory parents and retained cumulative campaign costs.
release_authorization: The user authorizes 0.2.4 publication; old tags and public assets stay immutable.
